# Reminders

* Remember to watch content videos early in the week, start the problem set, and be ready for the quiz on Friday.

* You can check how you are doing in the class using the Check Progress spreadsheet, linked under Course Materials (last item). Type in your T# and watch your results appear! (Be sure to delete your T# afterwards.)

* The [2027 Oberlin-in-London program](https://www.oberlin.edu/oberlin-in-london) will be entitled “Evolving London: Ways of Knowing a Changing World,” offering a sensory, place, and object-based “field guide” to the city through the lens of Charles Darwin’s Origin of Species. Applications open in September.

### Groups for first month

For the first month, these will be your assigned groups. **You should sit in a cluster with these folks each day that class meets.** 

<text style="background-color:yellow">ANGIE: COPY GROUPS FROM WEEK 1 AGENDA</text>

## Mon Aug 31

Finish case study "A tale of three lice" (about phylogenetic trees and their uses).

## Wed Sep 2

Begin UPGMA tree-building activity.

## Fri Sep 4

In teams, complete [Quiz 1](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSclHEk-m9EhZvut1CZE3PJMxdoBZuJkcr-QTfRjAFbJAB4t5A/viewform?usp=dialog) then go over incorrect responses with team. Each team submits 1 document of corrections for all questions someone in the team missed.
